text:
miriam: Quick flag — we brought up a PTQ variant of the reranker (ranky-3b-ptq) in the canary and overall NDCG looks OK but MRR for long queries tanked. Anyone free to triage? :thinking:

sam: Can you paste the eval command and define 'long'?
miriam: Eval: `./eval/run_eval.sh --model ranky-3b-ptq --baseline ranky-3b-fp16 --cohort golden-anchors-v2 --slices "len>=128,len<128" --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 --seed 42`
Long = queries with token_count >= 128.
eval-bot: From that run:
- overall ndcg@10: ptq 0.712 vs fp16 0.715 (delta -0.003)
- long queries mrr@10: ptq 0.396 vs fp16 0.432 (delta -0.036) :large_red_circle:
- short queries mrr@10: ptq 0.512 vs fp16 0.508 (delta +0.004)
Bootstrap p-values: overall ndcg p=0.18, long mrr p=0.0014

jon: Sounds like a top-of-list issue for long queries. First suspects: tokenizer parity (vocab/normalization), truncation/padding differences, or candidate ordering/ties. PTQ can subtly change logits and flip tie-breaks.
dinesh: Also verify retriever/topk didn't drift — reranker can look worse if candidate distribution shifts.
miriam: Retriever was pinned to `retriever@cb9f3c` same as baseline. We used the same docker image for tokenizer but maybe a different binary build ended up in the PTQ artifact.
sam: I'll run a tokenizer parity check and dump the top-5 candidate ids for the first 200 long queries. Script: `python tools/check_token_parity.py --model ranky-3b-ptq --baseline ranky-3b-fp16 --cohort golden-anchors-v2 --slice len>=128`
eval-bot: Token parity quick-check: 98.9% exact match, ~2.1% long queries show whitespace normalization diffs.
jon: 2% concentrated in head docs could explain top1 MRR drop. Also try `--preserve-candidate-order` to rule out tie-induced reordering.
dinesh: For stats, run a stratified bootstrap on MRR delta with 10k resamples and report 95% CI; split long into 128-256 and 256+ buckets.
miriam: Queued those checks. If the decrease is real in 256+ we should pause PTQ on rerank or adjust quantization clipping per-layer.
sam: I reran with preserve-order + exact tokenizer and uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/ranky3b/5076543210. New numbers: long MRR preserve-order ptq 0.402 vs fp16 0.431 (delta -0.029). Still a drop but smaller.
eval-bot: Bootstrap 95% CI for long MRR delta (ptq - fp16) with 10k resamples: [-0.042, -0.018] — excludes 0.
miriam: Action items: (1) pause PTQ canary for rerank, (2) jon/dinesh experiment with per-layer clip tuning and targeted evals for 128-256 vs 256+, (3) sam produce a short artifact report with top-affected queries and tokenizer diffs (s3 link). I'll open an ops rollback ticket. :white_check_mark:
jon: I'll try clip tuning and run targeted evals by EOD. If we recover top1 for 256+ with small clip changes we can reattempt PTQ.
dinesh: Adding a runtime trace for kv-cache/padding behavior in PTQ path — long contexts sometimes hit a different codepath.
miriam: Thanks all for the quick triage. Ping me if you find a smoking gun. :raised_hands:
